ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the central 75% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated in the distal 25% near the lateral tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe tip (viewer perspective) contains a broad high-intensity white patch with internal low-intensity mottling. localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned light-colored linear scratches visible on the dark pigmented surface of the right lobe, oriented diagonally.
